name: plane_compressible_foam_press_slide
parameter_origin: Illustrative synthetic values; not measured properties of a named commercial material.
model_notes: One-term compressible hyperfoam with provisional shear and bulk relaxation.
No permanent crushing, pore-fluid transport, or resolved foam cells.
The adapter must verify the exact ANSYS hyperfoam coefficient convention and Prony compatibility.

The slab is 10 mm thick, not the 3 mm the other cases use. At 5 N a 3 mm slab of this foam compressed by 1.6 mm - over half its thickness, on a 5 kPa Ogden modulus under 9.4 kPa of mean pressure - and kept creeping in the hold as the Prony branches relaxed under constant load until its elements inverted. Ten millimetres puts the same load at roughly 15% compression, which keeps the comparison at one shared force.
